requirement: Widget accepts completed plain speech without state mutations, failed-message duplication or replay

oracle.invariant: Valid empty-argument status tool followed by HTTP200 stop plain final returns speech and preserves brief, choices and server facts. A bounded plain conversational stop answer before any tool returns speech only; malformed JSON, unsafe text, refusals, truncated output and invalid status tools still refuse without retry. Signed-in structured output cannot open login; diagnostic metadata never includes raw keys, prompt, history, body, tool arguments or URLs. Failed turns remove only their optimistic row; pending words are deduplicated and remain manual while microphone readiness preserves the model error. Playback failure cannot park an answered turn as unsent.
oracle.productSourcesScope: file-level: the files the case imports, reads or runs (declaration line, or the first code line); the invariant is exercised through them, the executed assertion is the case command

writes: run dir under QA_ARTIFACT_ROOT: logs/, tmp/<case> (the child TMPDIR, removed after the run)
